tei:div.tei:p: 101) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rig 'dzin bla ma'i don bskang dngos grub snye ma bzhugs: no mo padma kā ra ye:

rnal 'byor rim gnyis lam zhugs pas: nyams chag bskang dang tshogs rdzogs phyir: rig 'dzin don bskang zab mo bstan: sa ma ya: thabs shes rdzas dang bza' bca'i rigs: bldag gzhib la sogs 'byor tshogs kun: rnam gsum dag pa'i yo byad bsags: sbyangs spel nus pas bdud rtsir bsgyur: snyan dbyangs thod rnga'i sgra dang bcas: byin gyis rlob pa 'di skad do: oṃ: kun khyab yangs pa'i gtor snod du: āḥ kun snang 'dod yon tshogs su bshams: hūm̐: kun 'byung ye shes bdud rtsir brlabs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum dang: nam mkha'i mdzod sngags lan bdun gyis brlabs la: spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: 'gro ba'i don du gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa: thabs mkhas thugs rje'i mdzad pa cir yang ston: rgyal kun gsang gsum yon tan mi zad gter: rang bzhin dbyings kyi zhing na bzhugs pa yi: dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang: theg dgu'i yi dam gnas yul mkha' 'gro dang: 'jig 'das dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams kun: 102) rmad byung gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dbu skra mdzes pa'i thor cog ldems se ldem: dar dang rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo: dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis gar 'cham shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis glu dbyangs ti ri ri: phaṭa dang pheṃ sgra mang po sangs se sang: dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa thu lu lu: ye shes 'ja' dang 'od phung lams se lam: rig 'dzin sku dang thig le shigs se shig: dbang byin dngos grub char rgyun ta la la: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin gyis brlab tu gsol: mchog thun su kha'i dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: oṃ āḥgu ru bidyā dha ra bam̐ ha ri ni sa sarba dharma pā la kṣe tra pā la badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de nas bskang ba dngos ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams nas: dang po'i sangs rgyas kun gyi yab: kun bzang yab yum thugs dam bskang:

bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: nges pa lnga ldan zhing khams nas: rang bzhin lhun grub gdangs chen po: rigs lnga yab yum= bskang gyur= mi mjed sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: chos nyid don gyi dngos grub brnyes: dga' rab rdo rje'i= bskang gyur= gsang ba mngon gyur zhing khams nas: 'ja' 103) lus chos sku'i dngos grub brnyes: shrī seng ha'i= bskang gyur= 'od gsal chen po'i zhing khams nas: rtogs grol dgongs pa'i shes rab brdol: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen= bskang gyur= shes rab rang gsal zhing khams nas: 'pho med nam mkha'i rang bzhin can: bi ma mi tra'i= bskang gyur= dpal ri pad 'od zhing khams nas: rig 'dzin dgongs pa rnam bzhi grub: padma thod phreng= bskang gyur= dbyings ye rnam dag zhing khams nas: bla med gsang ba'i snod mchog ldan: mkhar chen mtsho rgyal thugs= bskang gyur= lhun grub dag pa'i zhing khams nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub brnyes: rje 'bangs rnams kyi= bskang gyur= bde chen 'khor lo'i zhing khams nas: theg dgu'i gnad smin grub brnyes mchog: las 'brel rtsal gyi= bskang gyur= bde stong mi 'gyur zhing khams nas: zag med bde ba'i sku brnyes pa: bde chen dkar mo'i thugs= bskang gyur= gang 'dul thugs rje'i zhing khams nas: smon lam 'phro sad 'gro ba'i mgon: zab gter brgyud pa'i= bskang gyur= phyi nang dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa yi: dngos grub 104)kun gyi 'byung gnas cheḥ theg dgu'i yi dam= bskang gyur= gnas yul skyong zhing gsang sngags bdag: 'jig 'das srung ma'i= bskang gyur= thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas niḥ phyi mchod rnam lngas thugs dam bskang: nang mchod gzugs sgra dri ro reg: bde chen chos kyi thugs= gsang mchod sman gtor rakta dang: kho na nyid kyi mchod pas bskang: bskang gyur= lta ba blo 'das chen por bskang: sgom pa zang thal rol par bskang: spyod pa blang dor bral bar bskang: 'bras bu ye grol klong du bskang:

bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hoḥ rtsa gsum srung mar bcas pa dgongs: bdag cag ma rig sgrib dbang gis: rdo rje slob dpon drug dang 'gal: mched bzhi'i sku la gnod pa dang: sngags gsum phyag rgya ral ba sogs: gsang sngags gzhung bzhin ma byas pa'i: nyams chag 'gal 'das zhig ral gyi: nyes byas gang bsags thams cad kun: bla ma lha yi spyan snga ru: rab gnong 'gyod pa drag po yis: snying nas bshags so bzod par bzhes: nyams chag sdig sgrib kun dag nas: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa 105)tsakra sa twa= sogs/ āḥ zhes brjod nyams chag kun bskang nas: rim gnyis lam mchog mngon gyur nges: sa ma ya: de ltar rig 'dzin don bskang 'dir: sus brtson byin rlabs dngos grub thob: las can bu dang 'phrad par shog: log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: thub par srungs shig sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu hya: brda thim: : zhes pa 'di yang chos 'di'i bka' bab 'dul ba 'dzin pa mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang*/ shī la badzra sogs kyis yang yang bskul ngor rje btsun bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs/ bde chen bde ba'i rdo rjes ser dgon dben khrod nas mnyam gzhag rig pa'i gab sgrom rjes thob phrin las yig ris su bkod pa'o// dge'o// 106)
